wiki.title: Barbara Washington
wiki.extract: Barbara Anne Washington is an American politician and attorney who currently serves as a member of the Missouri Senate from the 9th district. Elected to the Senate in 2020, she was previously a member of the Missouri House of Representatives for the 23rd district from 2018 to 2021.
